item.title: Technical Specifications for Digital Images
item.description:
This repository is currently under construction. The document you’re reading may be edited, moved, or deleted entirely.

Technical Specifications for Digital Images

Primary and Service Files

  • The Primary File (u) is saved in 16-bit Adobe RGB and includes an object level target (OLT). This is considered the preservation file.

  • The Service File (s) is intended for digital display. It is 8-Bit sRGB and has been cropped to exclude the object level target (OLT).
